name: @vssaros/dsh-sessions
description: VsSaros Sessions module for DeepSeek Harness: the history-session side view rendered by dsh itself — sessions grouped by workspace (cwd), each group showing 5 idle sessions with 'expand more', running / waiting-for-user sessions always visible and not counting against the quota, plus the in-session persona mark (vssaros-persona projection). Read-only over dsh's session projection cache (<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions), optionally merged field-by-field with live sessions via sessions.get + sessionProjections.stateOf. No tools. ⚠ 2026-10-12：入口是**自己的容器** `vssaros.dsh.sessions`（page-only，order 120）—— 刻意**不借用**常驻容器 `sessionHistory.view`：那是 `DSH_ALWAYS_REGISTERED_CONTAINERS` 的一员，两条既有守卫禁止它与模块容器表重叠；而且让常驻那格改挂插件页等于把另一条流**正在改**的壳侧 DOM pane 就地换掉（协调决定，不是实现细节）⇒ 两个入口暂时并存：常驻的「历史会话」+ 本页「历史会话（插件页）」。
